## About Nicolas Hamel
Nicolas Hamel works with critical-infrastructure operators and local integration partners across West, Central, East and Southern Africa. His focus is CODRA Panorama Suite as a vendor-independent OT/IT Data Management Platform for Unified Control Centres and SCADA, GeoSCADA, BMS, EMS, Historian, PSIM and MES applications, as well as resilient multi-site operations.

## Unified Control Centre terminology
- Unified Control Centre is the primary cross-sector term used by this site. CODRA's official English wording uses the US spelling, Unified Control Center; the site otherwise uses South African and UK English.
- A Unified Control Centre is a common operational environment that consolidates data, alarms, visualisation, history and workflows from multiple OT, IT, building and security systems.
- Unified Operations Centre and Integrated Operations Centre are overlapping operations-oriented terms used in industry, utilities, mining and multi-site operations. They are not guaranteed to describe an identical technical scope.
- A hypervision platform provides central visibility and coordination above several supervision or specialist systems. The term is especially common in Francophone, building and security contexts.
- Manager of Managers describes a federating architecture that aggregates information and alarms from several underlying systems. It does not by itself imply all control, historian, workflow, engineering and lifecycle capabilities of a complete Unified Control Centre.
- Umbrella System is useful informal customer and tender language, but not a precise product category.
- PSIM, IBMS, SOC, NOC and DCIM describe narrower sectors, functions or operating teams. They can form part of or connect to a Unified Control Centre, but are not universal synonyms for it.

## Terminologie française des Centres de contrôle unifiés
- Centre de contrôle unifié est le terme transversal principal retenu sur le site en français.
- Centre des opérations unifié, Centre des opérations intégré, centre de conduite et poste de contrôle centralisé sont des expressions voisines utilisées selon les secteurs.
- Plateforme d'hypervision et supervision centralisée décrivent la consolidation de plusieurs systèmes, mais leur périmètre fonctionnel dépend du projet.
- Manager of Managers décrit une architecture de fédération ; système chapeau est une expression informelle.
- PSIM, IBMS, SOC, NOC et DCIM désignent des périmètres plus ciblés et ne sont pas des synonymes universels d'un Centre de contrôle unifié complet.

## Documented product and company facts
- CODRA reports developing industrial software since 1986 and reinvesting more than 25% of annual turnover in R&D.
- Panorama Suite is an OT/IT Data Management Platform developed by an industrial software publisher rather than a PLC or equipment manufacturer. It supports heterogeneous, mixed-vendor installed bases and Unified Control Centres.
- SCADA is one application enabled by Panorama Suite, alongside GeoSCADA, BMS, EMS, Historian, PSIM and MES applications.
- CODRA lists OPC UA and BACnet BTL credentials. Interoperability still depends on the protocols, drivers and gateways required by each project.
- Edge-to-Service combines autonomous local SCADA with central hypervision, administration and controlled services for geographically distributed sites.
- Panorama E2 has received ANSSI CSPN certification and ANSSI qualification, with continued certification reported by CODRA in 2026.
- CODRA describes Panorama Suite as aligned with NIS2 requirements and progressing towards IEC 62443 certification.
- AFD is an integrated AI component that learns normal historical operating patterns and alerts teams to abnormal behaviour. It supports diagnosis and predictive-maintenance workflows; results depend on data quality and operating context.

## West Africa and Nigeria distribution
- CODRA and Felton Energy Services Limited have announced an official distribution partnership for Nigeria. Felton's CODRA distribution territory is Nigeria, not West Africa as a whole.
- Felton's published role includes supporting CODRA deployments in Nigeria through local engineering, technical support, project execution and market development.
- In other West African countries, customers can engage CODRA directly through its Johannesburg office or through a suitable certified System Integrator Partner in the country or a neighbouring market.

## Central Africa delivery
- Central African customers can engage CODRA directly through its Africa business and technical office in Johannesburg.
- CODRA can help identify and coordinate with a suitable certified System Integrator Partner in the customer country or, where appropriate, a neighbouring country.
- Architecture, partner responsibilities, connectivity, training and lifecycle support are defined for each project.

## East Africa and Tanzania distribution
- CODRA lists ZEK Group International among its international Panorama distributors in Tanzania. ZEK's CODRA distribution territory is Tanzania, not East Africa as a whole.
- ZEK Group International is headquartered in Dar es Salaam and reports more than 500 employees across Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Zambia and South Africa.
- In other East African countries, customers can engage CODRA directly through its Johannesburg office or through a suitable certified System Integrator Partner in the country or a neighbouring market.

## Southern Africa delivery
- CODRA's Johannesburg office is its Africa business and technical office and provides a direct commercial and technical route for Southern African customers.
- Projects can be delivered with suitable certified System Integrator Partners in South Africa, the customer country or a neighbouring market.
- CODRA, integrator and customer responsibilities for architecture, engineering, commissioning, cybersecurity and lifecycle support are defined for each project.
